fullContentHtml:
BSSC Field Assistant Mains Online Form 2026 – Full Details

Bihar Staff Selection Commission (BSSC) has released the mains form notification for the post of Field Assistant. This recruitment has been issued for 201 posts. The online application process for BSSC Field Assistant Mains Online Form 2026 has started from 22 October 2026, and candidates can apply till 31 October 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for BSSC Field Assistant Mains Online Form 2026, which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 11 April 2025
  • Application Start Date : 25 April 2025
  • Last Date : 23 May 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 21 May 2025
  • Exam Date : 10 August 2025
  • Admit Card : 30 July 2025
  • Answer Key : 11 September 2025
  • Result : 23 January 2026
  • Mains Form
  • Application Start Date : 22 October 2026
  • Last Date : 31 October 2026

Application Fee

  • General, BC, EBC : Rs. 540/-
  • Other State (All Category) : Rs. 540/-
  • All Category Female (Bihar) : Rs.135/-
  • SC, ST, PH Candidates : Rs.135/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.

BSSC Field Assistant Mains Online Form 2026 is the official result announcement. Candidates can check their scorecard and merit status via the direct link above.
